title: Fix the Broken Calculator
description: The following calculator function has several bugs. Find and fix all the bugs to make it work correctly.
context: A simple calculator function was written but it's not working correctly. Users have reported that division doesn't work, subtraction gives wrong results, and it crashes with certain inputs.
requirements: Fix the division operation (currently always returns 0)
Fix the subtraction operation (currently adds instead of subtracts)
Add error handling for division by zero
Ensure all operations return correct numeric results
success_criteria: Division by zero is handled gracefully
hints: Look carefully at the subtraction operation
Check what type of division is being used
Add a check for zero before dividing
